create_sampler_instance: create a DPM-Solver++ 2S Sampler instance with a denoiser and noise level configuration parameters
run_diffusion_sampling: run the Sampler on input data with a targets template to generate denoised output via reverse diffusion
configure_noise_schedule: configure the noise schedule by setting max noise level, min noise level, num noise levels, and rho parameter
enable_stochastic_churn: enable stochastic churn by setting a positive churn rate with min and max noise level bounds
review_sampler_call_method: review the Sampler __call__ method that performs iterative denoising using a fori loop over noise levels
